summary: Fully reviewed Console/CLI guide; corrected current conventional mode, IAM creation guards, complete VPC prerequisites, API CIDRs, AL2023, waiters and explicit operator access.

Missing explicit operator access entries; default kubeconfig/context and getnodes alone are insufficient validation.

summary: Fully read and corrected all15questions and both exercises, preserving useful capacity/configuration examples and explicitly bounding runtime claims.
findings: Corrected node Pod-capacity question/formula; all10table values match AWS VPC CNI source. Distinguished per-ENI limits, subnet exhaustion, prefix slots and managed maxPods caps.
Corrected NetworkPolicy default isolation and native VPC CNI support; removed unconfigured CNI installs and unsafe shared-namespace blanket-deny guidance.
Fixed both missing CloudFormation subnet-route-table associations, NAT/IGW placement and private-IPv4 scope; explicitly labeled the one-AZ template as a routing demonstration, not a complete EKS VPC.
Removed duplicate basicQ4, corrected SecurityGroupPolicy selector/ENIConfig requirements and nonexistent eksctl flags, and replaced obsolete CNI/mysql copy commands.
Corrected prefix delegation capacity, contiguous /28 requirements, warm-pool semantics and migration; removed invented latency causes and guaranteed efficiency claims.

Corrected CoreDNS managed add-on configuration ownership and preserved existing values; fixed invalid prefetch duration/autopath syntax and explained reload, validation and single autoscaler ownership.

Narrowed tenant RBAC to explicit application resources; quotas, policy and RBAC remain platform-owned. Repaired English flattened YAML and cross-namespace DNS selectors; documented workload-created Secret/identity exposure and shared-cluster limits.
Corrected Kubernetes-version relevance to instance/AMI selection, 14+12month EKS support, PDB limits/percentage rounding, update sequencing and unsupported update command.
Corrected CA/Karpenter/HPA/VPA responsibilities; rendered CAchart9.59.0 with explicitv1.36.1 for EKS1.36. Added VPA recommendation-only mode and removed competing direct-ASG scaling recipes.

Rebuilt Calico exercise with complete AWS-VPC-networking prerequisites and aggregated API, dedicated namespace, explicit protocols/DNS, three-tier TCP baseline/positive controls and UID-guarded cleanup. PostgreSQL17 temporary data and unexecuted runtime assumptions are explicit.

Scoped IRSA to an existing approved S3training/prefix, exactOIDCaud/sub and unique recorded role. Removed environment dumps, added actual-role verification and controlled missing-credentials comparison; retained namespaceUID/RoleId cleanup guards.

Corrected mixed-instance shape/capacity-type rules and removed unsupported spotAllocationStrategy/metadataOptions fields. Replaced whole-Deployment pseudo-canary with a separate canary and removed instant rollback/availability guarantees.
Corrected node IAM/IMDS/EBS-versus-API-encryption/logging guidance and ensured the network-policy demonstration uses controller-managed Pods. No historic benchmark was rerun or fabricated.
validation: Full read of every original line: EN1–2890, KO1–2907; original SHA256 and incremental read ranges preserved in progress.json.
Final paired structure:15questions and17details per locale; whole-document code parity and scoped git diff --check pass.

CloudFormation cfn-lint:zero diagnostics; both route associations manually verified. cfn-guard and cloud pre-deployment validation were not run; no infrastructure deployment.
